newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Local investment bank Fator said it was maintaining its buy recommendation on state-owned telecoms firm Telesp, a unit of federally owned Telebras serving Sao Paulo State.
-- The bank cited Telesp's strong results for the first seven months, saying the figures confirm rising profits for the company, with higher revenues and yields ahead.
-- The firm posted January-July net income of 453 million reais and net revenues of 1.985 billion reais, up 65 percent from the same period last year, Fator said.
-- Moreover, "Telesp has the highest level of digitalization of all the telecommunications companies we know, as well as the best growth potential in the cellular telephone sector," it said.
-- Telesp's preferred traded off one real at 199 reais at 1120 local/1420 GMT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
